        --codex-shadow-light: 0 12px 24px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.08);
        --codex-shadow-heavy: 0 16px 36px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.08);
        --codex-bg-warm: rgba(248, 246, 241, 0.92);
        --codex-bg-warm-gradient: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(248, 246, 241, 0.98), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98));
        --codex-bg-card: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98), rgba(248, 246, 241, 0.92));
        --codex-bg-hero: radial-gradient(circle at top right, var(--codex-border-gold), transparent 30%), var(--codex-bg-warm-gradient);
        --codex-gradient-dark: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--codex-dark), var(--codex-dark-mid));
        --codex-gradient-gold: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(240, 205, 148, 0.96), rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.96));
        --codex-gradient-gold-hover: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(250, 230, 194, 0.98), rgba(210, 170, 108, 0.98));
        --codex-transition: transform 160ms ease, box-shadow 160ms ease;
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Global Accessibility
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      /* C1: Focus indicators for keyboard navigation */
      :focus-visible {
        outline: 2px solid var(--codex-gold);
        outline-offset: 2px;
      }

      /* Reduced motion: disable all transitions and animations */
      @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
        *, *::before, *::after {
          animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
          animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
          transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
          scroll-behavior: auto !important;
        }
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Defensive / Hardening Rules
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      /* Prevent horizontal overflow — on body only (html overflow breaks position:sticky) */
      body {
        overflow-x: hidden;
      }

      /* Force font-display:swap on any @font-face loaded from snapshot */
      @font-face {
        font-display: swap !important;
      }

      /* CSS containment: editorial sections are independent paint/layout regions */
      .codex-editorial-section,
      .codex-editorial-card,
      .codex-editorial-action-bar,
      .codex-editorial-hero,
      .codex-editorial-jump-nav {
        contain: layout style;
      }

      /* Defer rendering of off-screen editorial sections (only when already visible — avoids conflict with scroll reveal) */
      .codex-editorial-section.is-visible,
      .codex-editorial-card.is-visible {
        content-visibility: auto;
        contain-intrinsic-size: auto 300px;
      }

      /* Guard against long unbreakable strings */
      .codex-editorial-page,
      .codex-editorial-hero-copy,
      .codex-editorial-section,
      .codex-editorial-card,
      .codex-editorial-action-bar,
      .codex-editorial-snapshot-card,
      .codex-editorial-brief-card,
      .codex-editorial-step-copy,
      .codex-editorial-answer,
      .codex-product-support,
      .codex-product-cta,
      .codex-article-support,
      .codex-collection-support,
      .codex-growth-hub,
      .codex-legacy-redirect {
        overflow-wrap: break-word;
        word-break: break-word;
      }

      /* Flex/grid children must allow shrinking */
      .codex-editorial-hero-copy,
      .codex-editorial-step-copy,
      .codex-growth-hub__card,
      .codex-editorial-snapshot-card {
        min-width: 0;
      }

      /* Images should never exceed container */
      img {
        max-width: 100%;
        height: auto;
      }

      /* Ensure lazy-loaded images don't cause layout shift */
      img[loading="lazy"] {
        background: #f0eee9;
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Animations & Motion
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      /* Scroll-triggered reveal: sections fade up when entering viewport */
      .codex-editorial-section,
      .codex-editorial-card,
      .codex-editorial-action-bar,
      .codex-editorial-jump-nav {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(18px);
        transition: opacity 420ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1),
                    transform 420ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
      }

      .codex-editorial-section.is-visible,
      .codex-editorial-card.is-visible,
      .codex-editorial-action-bar.is-visible,
      .codex-editorial-jump-nav.is-visible {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }

      /* Hero entrance: fade up with slight stagger */
      .codex-editorial-hero {
        animation: codex-hero-enter 550ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) both;
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero .codex-editorial-kicker {
        animation: codex-fade-up 400ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) 100ms both;
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero h1 {
        animation: codex-fade-up 450ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) 180ms both;
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero .codex-editorial-answer {
        animation: codex-fade-up 400ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) 280ms both;
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero .codex-editorial-figure {
        animation: codex-fade-up 500ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1) 200ms both;
      }

      @keyframes codex-hero-enter {
        from {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translateY(24px);
        }
        to {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: translateY(0);
        }
      }

      @keyframes codex-fade-up {
        from {
          opacity: 0;
          transform: translateY(14px);
        }
        to {
          opacity: 1;
          transform: translateY(0);
        }
      }

      /* FAQ accordion: smooth open/close */
      .codex-editorial-faq details .codex-editorial-faq-body {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-rows: 0fr;
        transition: grid-template-rows 250ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq details[open] .codex-editorial-faq-body {
        grid-template-rows: 1fr;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq details .codex-editorial-faq-body > * {
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      /* FAQ +/- icon rotation */
      .codex-editorial-faq summary::before {
        transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1),
                    background-color 200ms ease,
                    color 200ms ease,
                    border-color 200ms ease;
      }

      /* Jump-nav pill: smooth active state transition */
      .codex-editorial-jump-link {
        transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1),
                    color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1),
                    border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1),
                    transform 160ms ease,
                    box-shadow 160ms ease;
      }

      /* Growth hub card: subtle lift on hover */
      .codex-growth-hub__card {
        transition: transform 250ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1),
                    border-color 250ms ease,
                    box-shadow 250ms cubic-bezier(0.25, 1, 0.5, 1);
      }

      /* L4: Skip-to-content link — visible on focus */
      a[href="#main"] {
        position: fixed;
        top: -100%;
        left: 1rem;
        z-index: 10000;
        padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-pill);
        background: var(--codex-dark);
        color: #fff;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: top 160ms ease;
      }

      a[href="#main"]:focus {
        top: 1rem;
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Shared Component Patterns
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      /* Eyebrow / kicker label — decorative, NOT interactive */
      .codex-product-cta__eyebrow,
      .codex-collection-cta__eyebrow,
      .codex-growth-hub__eyebrow,
      .codex-legacy-redirect__eyebrow,
      .codex-editorial-kicker,
      .codex-editorial-answer-label {
        margin: 0 0 0.45rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-product-cta__eyebrow { margin-bottom: 0.35rem; }
      .codex-collection-cta__eyebrow { letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
      .codex-editorial-answer-label { letter-spacing: 0.08em; }

      /* Pill button – shared base */
      .codex-product-cta__primary,
      .codex-collection-cta__primary,
      .codex-footer-rfq-link,
      .codex-legacy-redirect__action,
      .codex-growth-hub__action,
      .codex-editorial-link-card,
      .codex-editorial-brief-link,
      .codex-editorial-secondary,
      .codex-editorial-primary,
      .codex-editorial-jump-link {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        min-height: 2.85rem;
        padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-pill);
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: var(--codex-transition), background-color 160ms ease;
      }

      /* Pill button – dark variant */
      .codex-product-cta__primary,
      .codex-footer-rfq-link,
      .codex-legacy-redirect__action--primary {
        color: #fff;
        background: var(--codex-gradient-dark);
        box-shadow: var(--codex-shadow);
      }

      .codex-product-cta__primary:hover,
      .codex-footer-rfq-link:hover,
      .codex-legacy-redirect__action--primary:hover {
        transform: translateY(-1px);
        box-shadow: var(--codex-shadow-light);
      }

      /* Pill button – outlined / ghost variant */
      .codex-legacy-redirect__action,
      .codex-growth-hub__action,
      .codex-editorial-link-card,
      .codex-editorial-brief-link,
      .codex-editorial-secondary,
      .codex-editorial-jump-link {
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-editorial-jump-link {
        min-height: 2.75rem;
        padding: 0.7rem 1rem;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--codex-bg-warm), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98));
        border: 1px solid rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.1);
        font-size: 0.9rem;
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__action:hover,
      .codex-growth-hub__action:hover,
      .codex-editorial-link-card:hover,
      .codex-editorial-brief-link:hover,
      .codex-editorial-secondary:hover,
      .codex-editorial-primary:hover,
      .codex-editorial-jump-link:hover {
        transform: translateY(-1px);
        box-shadow: var(--codex-shadow-light);
      }

      /* Active/pressed state — subtle press-down feedback */
      .codex-product-cta__primary:active,
      .codex-collection-cta__primary:active,
      .codex-footer-rfq-link:active,
      .codex-legacy-redirect__action:active,
      .codex-growth-hub__action:active,
      .codex-editorial-link-card:active,
      .codex-editorial-brief-link:active,
      .codex-editorial-secondary:active,
      .codex-editorial-primary:active,
      .codex-editorial-jump-link:active {
        transform: translateY(0);
        box-shadow: none;
        transition-duration: 50ms;
      }

      .codex-editorial-jump-link:hover {
        border-color: rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.28);
      }

      /* Pill button – gold / accent variant (primary CTA) */
      .codex-editorial-primary {
        background: var(--codex-gradient-dark);
        color: #fff;
        font-weight: 700;
        box-shadow: var(--codex-shadow);
        padding: 0.8rem 1.4rem;
        font-size: 1rem;
      }

      /* Pill button – green variant (collection) */
      .codex-collection-cta__primary {
        color: #fff;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1f5f47, #0d3a2b);
        box-shadow: 0 10px 22px rgba(13, 58, 43, 0.18);
        font-weight: 700;
      }

      .codex-collection-cta__primary:hover {
        transform: translateY(-1px);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 22px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.14);
      }

      /* Action row – shared flex layout for button groups */
      .codex-product-cta__actions,
      .codex-collection-cta__actions,
      .codex-growth-hub__actions,
      .codex-legacy-redirect__actions,
      .codex-editorial-link-list,
      .codex-editorial-action-links,
      .codex-editorial-brief-links,
      .codex-editorial-jump-links {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.75rem;
      }

      .codex-product-cta__actions,
      .codex-legacy-redirect__actions {
        margin-top: 1rem;
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__actions { margin-top: 1.25rem; gap: 0.8rem; }
      .codex-growth-hub__actions { gap: 0.8rem; grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      .codex-editorial-link-list,
      .codex-editorial-action-links,
      .codex-editorial-brief-links { gap: 0.8rem; }

      /* Support / card panel – shared pattern for info grids */
      .codex-product-support,
      .codex-article-support,
      .codex-collection-support {
        padding: 1.5rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card);
      }

      .codex-product-support {
        margin: 2rem 0 2.5rem;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.9), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98));
      }

      .codex-article-support {
        margin: 2.5rem 0 0;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(245, 245, 245, 0.85), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98));
      }

      .codex-collection-support {
        margin: 1.5rem 0 2rem;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--codex-bg-warm), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.98));
      }

      /* ── Collection Buying Support (redesigned) ── */

      .codex-collection-buying-support {
        margin: 1.5rem 0 2rem;
        display: grid;
        gap: 1.25rem;
      }

      /* Collection CTA — redesigned as a horizontal card */
      .codex-collection-cta {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1rem;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr auto;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1e150b 0%, #3a2a16 100%);
        color: #f0e8dd;
        border: none;
      }

      .codex-collection-cta h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.35rem;
        font-size: 1.25rem;
        line-height: 1.25;
        color: #fff;
      }

      .codex-collection-cta__copy p:last-child {
        margin-bottom: 0;
        color: #d4c5b0;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        line-height: 1.55;
      }

      .codex-collection-cta__brief {
        margin: 0.75rem 0 0;
        padding: 0;
        list-style: none;
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.35rem 1.25rem;
      }

      .codex-collection-cta__brief li {
        display: flex;
        align-items: baseline;
        gap: 0.4rem;
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        color: #c8b89e;
      }

      .codex-collection-cta__check {
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        font-weight: 700;
      }

      .codex-collection-cta__brief li + li {
        margin-top: 0;
      }

      .codex-collection-cta__actions {
        grid-row: 1 / -1;
        align-self: center;
      }

      .codex-collection-cta__primary {
        white-space: nowrap;
        background: var(--codex-gold) !important;
        color: var(--codex-dark) !important;
        font-weight: 700;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.3);
      }

      .codex-collection-cta__primary:hover {
        box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.4);
      }

      /* Collection Guidance — redesigned as numbered steps */
      .codex-collection-guidance {
        padding: 1.5rem 1.75rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7);
      }

      .codex-collection-guidance__title {
        margin: 0 0 1.15rem;
        font-size: 1.15rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-collection-guidance__steps {
        list-style: none;
        margin: 0;
        padding: 0;
        display: grid;
        gap: 0;
      }

      .codex-collection-guidance__step {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 2.4rem 1fr;
        gap: 0.75rem;
        padding: 1rem 0;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        align-items: start;
      }

      .codex-collection-guidance__step:first-child {
        border-top: none;
        padding-top: 0;
      }

      .codex-collection-guidance__step:last-child {
        padding-bottom: 0;
      }

      .codex-collection-guidance__num {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 2.2rem;
        height: 2.2rem;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--codex-bg-warm);
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        color: var(--codex-dark-mid);
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        flex-shrink: 0;
      }

      .codex-collection-guidance__body strong {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 0.25rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 0.95rem;
      }

      .codex-collection-guidance__body p {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        line-height: 1.6;
      }

      /* Support grids */
      .codex-product-support__grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1.25rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
      }

      .codex-article-support__grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1.25rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      }

      /* Support panel headings */
      .codex-product-support__panel h2,
      .codex-article-support__panel h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.85rem;
        font-size: 1.15rem;
      }

      /* Support dl resets */
      .codex-product-procurement dl,
      .codex-article-guidance dl {
        margin: 0;
      }

      /* Support row separators */
      .codex-product-support__row + .codex-product-support__row,
      .codex-article-support__row + .codex-article-support__row {
        margin-top: 0.85rem;
        padding-top: 0.85rem;
        border-top: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
      }

      .codex-product-support__row dt,
      .codex-article-support__row dt {
        margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-product-support__row dd,
      .codex-article-support__row dd {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      /* ── Blog Index ── */

      .codex-blog-index {
        max-width: 1100px;
        margin: 2rem auto 3rem;
        padding: 0 1rem;
      }

      .codex-blog-index__header {
        margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      }

      .codex-blog-index__header h1 {
        margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
        font-size: 1.75rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-blog-index__header p {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 1rem;
        line-height: 1.5;
      }

      /* Topic filter pills */
      .codex-blog-index__topics {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        margin-bottom: 2rem;
        padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
      }

      .codex-blog-pill {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.35rem;
        padding: 0.4rem 0.85rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-pill);
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 150ms ease;
      }

      .codex-blog-pill:hover {
        border-color: var(--codex-gold);
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-blog-pill--active {
        background: var(--codex-dark);
        border-color: var(--codex-dark);
        color: #fff;
      }

      .codex-blog-pill--active:hover {
        background: var(--codex-dark-mid);
        color: #fff;
      }

      .codex-blog-pill span {
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        opacity: 0.6;
      }

      /* Card grid */
      .codex-blog-index__grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      }

      .codex-blog-grid-card {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        padding: 1.25rem 1.35rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card);
        background: #fff;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: transform 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease;
      }

      .codex-blog-grid-card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        border-color: rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.35);
        box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.07);
      }

      .codex-blog-grid-card__thumb {
        width: 100%;
        aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
        object-fit: cover;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card);
        margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
        background: var(--codex-bg-warm);
      }

      .codex-blog-grid-card__tag {
        display: inline-block;
        align-self: flex-start;
        margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
        padding: 0.2rem 0.55rem;
        border-radius: 4px;
        background: var(--codex-bg-warm);
        color: var(--codex-dark-mid);
        font-size: 0.7rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-blog-grid-card strong {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 1rem;
        line-height: 1.35;
      }

      .codex-blog-grid-card p {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        line-height: 1.55;
        flex-grow: 1;
      }

      .codex-blog-grid-card__cta {
        display: inline-block;
        margin-top: 0.85rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        font-weight: 600;
      }

      @media (max-width: 900px) {
        .codex-blog-index__grid {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        }
      }

      @media (max-width: 560px) {
        .codex-blog-index__grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
      }

      /* ── Product Spec Sheet ── */

      .codex-product-spec-sheet {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1.5rem;
        grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 0.6fr;
        margin: 1.5rem 0;

      }

      .codex-footer-rfq-link {
        min-height: 2.7rem;
        padding: 0.68rem 1rem;
        color: #fff !important;
        box-shadow: 0 12px 24px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.18);
      }

      .codex-footer-rfq-link:hover {
        color: #fff !important;
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Product CTA Block
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-product-cta {
        margin: 1.35rem 0 2rem;
        padding: 1.35rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        border-radius: 22px;
        background: var(--codex-bg-hero);
        box-shadow: 0 16px 34px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.08);
      }

      .codex-product-cta h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.55rem;
        font-size: clamp(1.45rem, 1.28rem + 0.35vw, 1.8rem);
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-product-cta__copy p:last-child {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-product-cta__brief {
        margin: 1rem 0 0;
        padding-left: 1.15rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-product-cta__brief li + li {
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Article FAQ (inside support panels)
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-article-faq {
        margin-top: 1.25rem;
      }

      .codex-article-faq details {
        border-top: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        padding-top: 0.85rem;
        margin-top: 0.85rem;
      }

      .codex-article-faq details:first-of-type {
        margin-top: 0;
        padding-top: 0;
        border-top: 0;
      }

      .codex-article-faq summary {
        cursor: pointer;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-article-faq p {
        margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Collection CTA Block
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Growth Hub Block
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-growth-hub {
        margin: 2rem 0;
        padding: 1.5rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.1);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-xl);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top right, var(--codex-border-gold), transparent 28%),
          var(--codex-bg-warm-gradient);
        box-shadow: 0 18px 36px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.08);
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__hero,
      .codex-growth-hub__group,
      .codex-growth-hub__brief {
        padding: 1.25rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__group,
      .codex-growth-hub__brief {
        margin-top: 1rem;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__hero h2,
      .codex-growth-hub__group h2,
      .codex-growth-hub__brief h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.65rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__hero p:last-child,
      .codex-growth-hub__group p:last-child,
      .codex-growth-hub__brief p:last-child {
        margin-bottom: 0;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
        margin-top: 1rem;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__card {
        display: block;
        padding: 1rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.1);
        border-radius: 18px;
        background: var(--codex-bg-card);
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: var(--codex-transition), border-color 160ms ease;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        border-color: rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.3);
        box-shadow: 0 14px 28px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.08);
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__card-eyebrow {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
        font-size: 0.8rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__card strong {
        display: block;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__card span:last-child {
        display: block;
        margin-top: 0.45rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__brief {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1rem;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.2fr) minmax(0, 0.9fr);
        align-items: center;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__brief-list {
        margin: 0;
        padding-left: 1.15rem;
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__brief-list li + li {
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Quote Brief — Redesigned CTA Section
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-quote-brief {
        margin: 2.5rem 0;
        padding: 2px;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-xl);
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.4), rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.15), rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.25));
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__inner {
        display: grid;
        gap: 2rem;
        grid-template-columns: 1.1fr 0.9fr;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 2.5rem 2.5rem;
        border-radius: calc(var(--codex-radius-card-xl) - 2px);
        background: linear-gradient(160deg, #faf8f4 0%, #fff 40%, #faf8f4 100%);
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__eyebrow {
        margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.12em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__copy h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.6rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 3vw, 1.8rem);
        line-height: 1.2;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__copy > p:not(.codex-quote-brief__eyebrow) {
        margin: 0 0 1.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        line-height: 1.6;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__cta {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.75rem;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__btn {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        min-height: 2.85rem;
        padding: 0.7rem 1.4rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-pill);
        background: #fff;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: var(--codex-transition), background-color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__btn--primary {
        border-color: transparent;
        background: var(--codex-gradient-dark);
        color: #fff;
        box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.18);
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__btn:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.12);
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__btn--primary:hover {
        box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.22);
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__checklist {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 0;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__item {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.85rem;
        padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        line-height: 1.45;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__item:first-child {
        border-top: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__item:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__step-label {
        padding: 0 1rem 0.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
        font-size: 0.72rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__icon {
        flex-shrink: 0;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 2.2rem;
        height: 2.2rem;
        border-radius: 10px;
        background: rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.08);
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
      }

      .codex-quote-brief__icon svg {
        display: block;
      }

      @media (max-width: 767px) {
        .codex-quote-brief__inner {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
          padding: 1.5rem;
        }
      }

      .codex-growth-hub__action {
        min-height: 2.9rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Industry Selector (Homepage)
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-industry-selector {
        margin: 2.5rem auto;
        padding: 0 1.5rem;
        max-width: 1200px;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__header {
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 2rem;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__header h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
        font-size: 1.8rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__header p {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 1.05rem;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1.25rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__card {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        position: relative;
        padding: 1.4rem 1.6rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.08);
        border-left: 4px solid var(--accent, var(--codex-gold));
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.96);
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: transform 200ms ease, box-shadow 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.1);
        border-color: var(--accent, var(--codex-gold));
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__eyebrow {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
        color: var(--accent, var(--codex-gold-muted));
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__card strong {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 1.05rem;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__card span:nth-child(3) {
        display: block;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        line-height: 1.5;
        flex: 1;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__arrow {
        display: block;
        margin-top: 0.75rem;
        color: var(--accent, var(--codex-gold));
        font-size: 1.1rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        transition: transform 160ms ease;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__card:hover .codex-industry-selector__arrow {
        transform: translateX(4px);
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__compare {
        margin-top: 1.5rem;
        padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
        border-radius: 12px;
        background: rgba(248, 246, 241, 0.7);
        text-align: center;
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        line-height: 1.8;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__compare span {
        display: block;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-weight: 500;
        margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__compare a {
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
        text-decoration: none;
        font-weight: 500;
        transition: color 160ms ease;
      }

      .codex-industry-selector__compare a:hover {
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        text-decoration: underline;
      }

      @media (max-width: 640px) {
        .codex-industry-selector__grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        .codex-industry-selector__header h2 {
          font-size: 1.4rem;
        }

        .codex-industry-selector {
          padding: 0 1rem;
        }
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Trust Bar
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-trust-bar {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        justify-content: center;
        gap: 1.5rem;
        margin: 2rem 0;
        padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card);
        background: #fff;
      }

      .codex-trust-bar__item {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: center;
        text-align: center;
        gap: 0.15rem;
        min-width: 120px;
      }

      .codex-trust-bar__item strong {
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 1.15rem;
      }

      .codex-trust-bar__item span {
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 0.82rem;
      }

      @media (max-width: 767px) {
        .codex-trust-bar {
          gap: 1rem;
          padding: 1rem;
        }

        .codex-trust-bar__item {
          min-width: calc(50% - 1rem);
        }
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Contact RFQ Form
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      #contact-rfq-form {
        scroll-margin-top: 7rem;
      }

      #contact-rfq-form .kb-text-style-field::placeholder {
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72);
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Legacy Redirect Page
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-legacy-redirect-shell {
        min-height: 100vh;
        display: grid;
        place-items: center;
        padding: 2rem 1rem;
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top left, var(--codex-border-gold), transparent 26%),
          linear-gradient(180deg, var(--codex-bg-warm), rgba(255, 255, 255, 1));
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect {
        width: min(720px, 100%);
        padding: 1.5rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-xl);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94);
        box-shadow: 0 18px 42px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.08);
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect h1 {
        margin: 0 0 0.75rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__lead,
      .codex-legacy-redirect__meta,
      .codex-legacy-redirect p:last-of-type {
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__details {
        margin: 1rem 0;
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.85rem;
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__details div {
        padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card);
        background: var(--codex-bg-warm);
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__details dt {
        margin: 0 0 0.25rem;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__details dd {
        margin: 0;
        word-break: break-word;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__action {
        font-weight: 700;
      }

      .codex-legacy-redirect__action--primary {
        color: #fff;
        background: var(--codex-gradient-dark);
        border-color: transparent;
        box-shadow: 0 12px 26px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.14);
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Editorial Pages
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-editorial-page {
        max-width: min(1160px, calc(100% - 2rem));
        margin: 0 auto 3rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-trail {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
        padding-top: 3.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-subtle);
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        line-height: 1.4;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        overflow-wrap: break-word;
        word-break: break-word;
      }

      .codex-editorial-trail a {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        min-height: 44px;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-decoration-color: rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.3);
        text-underline-offset: 3px;
      }

      .codex-editorial-trail a:hover {
        text-decoration-color: var(--codex-gold);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1.5rem;
        align-items: center;
        grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.25fr) minmax(280px, 0.9fr);
        padding: 1.75rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.1);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-xl);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.16), transparent 38%),
          var(--codex-bg-warm-gradient);
        box-shadow: var(--codex-shadow-heavy);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero h1 {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: clamp(2rem, 1.7rem + 1vw, 2.8rem);
        line-height: 1.08;
        letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      }

      /* Page-type hero color variants */
      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="solution"] {
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-teal);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top left, var(--codex-teal-light), transparent 38%),
          var(--codex-bg-warm-gradient);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="solution"] .codex-editorial-kicker {
        color: var(--codex-teal);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="compare"] {
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-steel);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top left, var(--codex-steel-light), transparent 38%),
          var(--codex-bg-warm-gradient);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="compare"] .codex-editorial-kicker {
        color: var(--codex-steel);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="guide"] {
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-forest);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top left, var(--codex-forest-light), transparent 38%),
          var(--codex-bg-warm-gradient);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="guide"] .codex-editorial-kicker {
        color: var(--codex-forest);
      }

      .codex-editorial-hero[data-page-type="compatibility"] {
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-gold-muted);
      }

      .codex-editorial-answer {
        margin-top: 1rem;
        padding: 1rem 1.1rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-gold);
        border-radius: 18px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.88);
      }

      .codex-editorial-summary {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        line-height: 1.7;
      }

      .codex-editorial-jump-nav {
        margin-top: 1.5rem;
        padding: 1.1rem 1.2rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
        box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.55);
      }

      .codex-editorial-jump-nav .codex-editorial-kicker {
        margin-bottom: 0.65rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-snapshot-grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
      }

      .codex-editorial-snapshot-card {
        padding: 1rem;
        border-radius: 18px;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);
      }

      .codex-editorial-snapshot-card p {
        margin: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-snapshot-card p + p {
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-snapshot-link {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        min-height: 2.75rem;
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        font-weight: 700;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: color 160ms ease;
      }

      .codex-editorial-snapshot-link:hover {
        color: var(--codex-dark-mid);
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-underline-offset: 3px;
      }

      .codex-editorial-points,
      .codex-editorial-list {
        margin: 1rem 0 0;
        padding-left: 1.15rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-points li,
      .codex-editorial-list li {
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-editorial-points li + li,
      .codex-editorial-list li + li {
        margin-top: 0.55rem;
      }

      .codex-hero-cta {
        margin-top: 1.25rem;
      }

      .codex-hero-cta-btn {
        display: inline-block;
        padding: 0.75rem 2rem;
        background: var(--codex-gold);
        color: var(--codex-dark);
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 1rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card);
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: opacity 0.15s;
      }

      .codex-hero-cta-btn:hover {
        opacity: 0.88;
        color: var(--codex-dark);
      }

      .codex-hero-trust-bar {
        display: flex;
        gap: 1.5rem;
        margin-top: 1rem;
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-hero-trust-bar strong {
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
      }

      @media (max-width: 600px) {
        .codex-hero-trust-bar {
          flex-wrap: wrap;
          gap: 0.75rem;
        }
      }

      .codex-editorial-step-list {
        list-style: none;
        margin: 1rem 0 0;
        padding: 0 0 0 0.4rem;
        display: grid;
        gap: 0;
        position: relative;
      }

      /* Vertical connecting line */
      .codex-editorial-step-list::before {
        content: "";
        position: absolute;
        left: calc(0.4rem + 2.45rem);
        top: 1.5rem;
        bottom: 1.5rem;
        width: 2px;
        background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--codex-border), transparent);
        z-index: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-step {
        display: grid;
        gap: 0.8rem;
        grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
        align-items: start;
        padding: 0.85rem 0.65rem;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 1;
        border: none;
        border-radius: 0;
        background: transparent;
      }

      .codex-editorial-step-index {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        min-width: 4.9rem;
        min-height: 2.2rem;
        padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-pill);
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.96), rgba(108, 81, 39, 0.96));
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-editorial-step-copy {
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        line-height: 1.7;
      }

      .codex-editorial-callout {
        margin: 1.25rem 0;
        padding: 1.15rem 1.35rem;
        border-left: 3px solid var(--codex-gold);
        border-radius: 0 var(--codex-radius-card) var(--codex-radius-card) 0;
        background: var(--codex-bg-warm);
      }

      .codex-editorial-callout strong {
        display: block;
        margin-bottom: 0.3rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-editorial-callout p {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        line-height: 1.6;
      }

      .codex-editorial-callout__link {
        display: inline-block;
        margin-top: 0.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-decoration: none;
      }

      .codex-editorial-section a {
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        text-decoration: none;
        font-weight: 500;
      }

      .codex-editorial-section a:hover {
        text-decoration: underline;
      }

      .codex-editorial-figure {
        margin: 1rem 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-figure img {
        display: block;
        width: 100%;
        aspect-ratio: 16 / 9;
        object-fit: cover;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
      }

      .codex-editorial-section,
      .codex-editorial-card {
        margin-top: 2rem;
        padding: 1.5rem 1.65rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.1);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: var(--codex-bg-card);
      }

      .codex-editorial-action-bar {
        margin-top: 2.5rem;
        padding: 1.5rem 1.65rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.1);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: var(--codex-bg-card);
      }

      .codex-editorial-section[id],
      .codex-editorial-action-bar[id] {
        scroll-margin-top: 6rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-section h2,
      .codex-editorial-card h2,
      .codex-editorial-action-bar h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.8rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 1.5rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-section p,
      .codex-editorial-card p,
      .codex-editorial-action-bar p,
      .codex-editorial-brief-card p,
      .codex-editorial-brief-card dd {
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
      }

      .codex-editorial-section p:last-child,
      .codex-editorial-card p:last-child,
      .codex-editorial-action-bar p:last-child {
        margin-bottom: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-resource-grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1.25rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
        margin-top: 1.5rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-link-card strong {
        display: block;
      }

      .codex-editorial-link-card span {
        display: block;
        font-size: 0.92rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-brief-grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr));
        margin: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-brief-card {
        margin: 0;
        padding: 1rem;
        border-radius: 18px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.84);
      }

      .codex-editorial-brief-card dt {
        margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-weight: 700;
      }

      .codex-editorial-brief-card dd {
        margin: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table-wrap {
        overflow-x: auto;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: #fff;
        -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      }

      /* Scroll fade hint on small screens */
      @media (max-width: 767px) {
        .codex-editorial-table-wrap {
          background:
            linear-gradient(to right, #fff 85%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)) 100% 0 / 3rem 100% no-repeat,
            #fff;
        }
      }

      .codex-editorial-table {
        width: 100%;
        border-collapse: collapse;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table th,
      .codex-editorial-table td {
        padding: 0.85rem 1rem;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        text-align: left;
        vertical-align: top;
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        line-height: 1.5;
        overflow-wrap: break-word;
        word-break: break-word;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table thead th {
        background: var(--codex-dark);
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.04em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table thead th:first-child {
        border-radius: 13px 0 0 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table thead th:last-child {
        border-radius: 0 13px 0 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
        background: rgba(248, 246, 241, 0.5);
      }

      .codex-editorial-table tbody tr:last-child th,
      .codex-editorial-table tbody tr:last-child td {
        border-bottom: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-table tbody th {
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq details {
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq details + details {
        margin-top: 0.75rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq details:last-child {
        border-bottom: 0;
        padding-bottom: 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq summary {
        cursor: pointer;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-weight: 700;
        padding: 0.5rem 0;
        min-height: 2.75rem;
        list-style: none;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.65rem;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq summary::before {
        content: "+";
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        width: 1.6rem;
        height: 1.6rem;
        flex-shrink: 0;
        border-radius: 50%;
        background: var(--codex-bg-warm);
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 400;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        transition: transform 200ms ease, background-color 200ms ease;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker {
        display: none;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq details[open] > summary::before {
        content: "−";
        background: var(--codex-dark);
        color: #fff;
        border-color: transparent;
      }

      .codex-editorial-faq p {
        margin: 0.45rem 0 0 2.25rem;
      }

      /* Inline RFQ form */
      .codex-inline-rfq {
        margin-top: 2.5rem;
        padding: 2rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--codex-dark) 0%, #3d2a14 100%);
        color: #fff;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        font-size: 1.35rem;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq p {
        margin: 0 0 1.25rem;
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8);
        font-size: 0.95rem;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq-form {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 0.75rem;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq-row {
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.75rem;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq-row input {
        flex: 1;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq input,
      .codex-inline-rfq textarea {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 0.65rem 0.85rem;
        border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card);
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
        color: #fff;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        font-family: inherit;
        box-sizing: border-box;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq input::placeholder,
      .codex-inline-rfq textarea::placeholder {
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq input:focus,
      .codex-inline-rfq textarea:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: var(--codex-gold);
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq button {
        align-self: flex-start;
        padding: 0.7rem 2rem;
        border: none;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card);
        background: var(--codex-gold);
        color: var(--codex-dark);
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 0.95rem;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: opacity 0.15s;
      }

      .codex-inline-rfq button:hover {
        opacity: 0.88;
      }

      @media (max-width: 600px) {
        .codex-inline-rfq-row {
          flex-direction: column;
        }
      }

      /* Trust signals */
      .codex-trust-signals {
        margin-top: 2.5rem;
        padding: 1.75rem 2rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: var(--codex-bg-warm);
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
      }

      .codex-trust-stats {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
        gap: 1rem;
        text-align: center;
        margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
      }

      .codex-trust-stat strong {
        display: block;
        font-size: 1.35rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        line-height: 1.2;
      }

      .codex-trust-stat span {
        font-size: 0.78rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.03em;
      }

      .codex-trust-note {
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        text-align: center;
        margin: 0;
        line-height: 1.6;
      }

      @media (max-width: 600px) {
        .codex-trust-stats {
          grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        }
      }

      /* Pain point / solution section styles */
      .codex-editorial-section[data-section-type="pain"] {
        border-left: 3px solid #c0392b;
        padding-left: 1.25rem;
        background: rgba(192, 57, 43, 0.03);
        border-radius: 0 var(--codex-radius-card) var(--codex-radius-card) 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-section[data-section-type="pain"] h2::before {
        content: "⚠ ";
      }

      .codex-editorial-section[data-section-type="solution"] {
        border-left: 3px solid #27ae60;
        padding-left: 1.25rem;
        background: rgba(39, 174, 96, 0.03);
        border-radius: 0 var(--codex-radius-card) var(--codex-radius-card) 0;
      }

      .codex-editorial-section[data-section-type="solution"] h2::before {
        content: "✓ ";
      }

      .codex-editorial-section[data-section-type="results"] {
        border-left: 3px solid var(--codex-gold);
        padding-left: 1.25rem;
        background: rgba(195, 154, 95, 0.04);
        border-radius: 0 var(--codex-radius-card) var(--codex-radius-card) 0;
      }

      /* Action bar: strong CTA treatment */
      .codex-editorial-action-bar {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: space-between;
        gap: 1rem;
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-gold);
        background:
          radial-gradient(circle at top right, var(--codex-border-gold), transparent 40%),
          var(--codex-bg-card);
      }

      /* FAQ shell: lighter, supplementary feel */
      .codex-editorial-section.codex-editorial-faq-shell {
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
        border: 1px dashed rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.15);
      }

      /* Snapshot / at-a-glance sections: left accent colored by page type */
      .codex-editorial-section.codex-editorial-snapshot {
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-gold-muted);
      }

      [data-page-type="solution"] ~ .codex-editorial-section.codex-editorial-snapshot {
        border-left-color: var(--codex-teal);
      }

      [data-page-type="compare"] ~ .codex-editorial-section.codex-editorial-snapshot {
        border-left-color: var(--codex-steel);
      }

      [data-page-type="guide"] ~ .codex-editorial-section.codex-editorial-snapshot {
        border-left-color: var(--codex-forest);
      }

      /* Resource sections: grid-heavy, no card wrapper feel */
      .codex-editorial-section.codex-editorial-resource-shell {
        background: transparent;
        border: none;
        padding-left: 0;
        padding-right: 0;
        box-shadow: none;
      }

      /* Page-type colored action bar variants */
      [data-page-type="solution"] ~ .codex-editorial-action-bar {
        border-left-color: var(--codex-teal);
      }

      [data-page-type="solution"] ~ .codex-editorial-action-bar .codex-editorial-primary {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2c5454, var(--codex-teal));
      }

      [data-page-type="compare"] ~ .codex-editorial-action-bar {
        border-left-color: var(--codex-steel);
      }

      [data-page-type="guide"] ~ .codex-editorial-action-bar {
        border-left-color: var(--codex-forest);
      }

      [data-page-type="guide"] ~ .codex-editorial-action-bar .codex-editorial-primary {
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1b4332, var(--codex-forest));
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Conversion Blocks (Product & Article CTA)
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      .codex-conversion-shell {
        margin: 2.5rem 0 2rem;
        padding: 1.75rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        border-left: 4px solid var(--codex-gold);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-card-lg);
        background: var(--codex-bg-hero);
        box-shadow: var(--codex-shadow-heavy);
      }

      .codex-conversion-header {
        margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
      }

      .codex-conversion-kicker {
        margin: 0 0 0.4rem;
        color: var(--codex-gold-muted);
        font-size: 0.82rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        text-transform: uppercase;
      }

      .codex-conversion-header h2 {
        margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 1.4rem;
      }

      .codex-conversion-header p {
        margin: 0;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        line-height: 1.6;
      }

      .codex-conversion-grid {
        display: grid;
        gap: 1rem;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr));
      }

      .codex-conversion-card {
        padding: 1.15rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border-light);
        border-radius: 14px;
        background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.92);
      }

      .codex-conversion-card h3 {
        margin: 0 0 0.5rem;
        font-size: 1.05rem;
        color: var(--codex-text);
      }

      .codex-conversion-card p {
        margin: 0 0 0.65rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        line-height: 1.55;
      }

      .codex-conversion-list {
        margin: 0.5rem 0 0;
        padding-left: 1.1rem;
      }

      .codex-conversion-list li {
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        line-height: 1.55;
      }

      .codex-conversion-list li + li {
        margin-top: 0.4rem;
      }

      .codex-conversion-actions {
        display: flex;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
        gap: 0.65rem;
        margin-top: 0.85rem;
      }

      .codex-conversion-button {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        min-height: 2.85rem;
        padding: 0.75rem 1.2rem;
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-pill);
        background: var(--codex-gradient-dark);
        color: #fff;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-decoration: none;
        box-shadow: var(--codex-shadow);
        transition: var(--codex-transition), background-color 160ms ease;
      }

      .codex-conversion-button:hover {
        transform: translateY(-1px);
        box-shadow: var(--codex-shadow-light);
      }

      .codex-conversion-button:active {
        transform: translateY(0);
        box-shadow: none;
        transition-duration: 50ms;
      }

      .codex-conversion-link {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        min-height: 2.75rem;
        padding: 0.65rem 0;
        color: var(--codex-gold);
        font-weight: 600;
        font-size: 0.92rem;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: color 160ms ease;
      }

      .codex-conversion-link:hover {
        color: var(--codex-dark-mid);
        text-decoration: underline;
        text-underline-offset: 3px;
      }

      @media (max-width: 767px) {
        .codex-conversion-shell {
          padding: 1.25rem;
        }

        .codex-conversion-grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Product Catalog Grid
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      ul.products.columns-4 {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        gap: 1.75rem;
        list-style: none;
        padding: 0;
        margin: 1.5rem 0;
      }

      ul.products.columns-4 > li.product {
        display: flex;
        flex-direction: column;
        background: #fff;
        border-radius: 14px;
        overflow: hidden;
        box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(41, 28, 14, 0.06);
        transition: all 0.25s ease;
      }

      ul.products.columns-4 > li.product:hover {
        box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(124, 106, 79, 0.15);
        transform: translateY(-4px);
      }

      ul.products.columns-4 > li.product img {
        width: 100%;
        aspect-ratio: 4 / 3;
        object-fit: cover;
        background: #f8f6f2;
      }

      ul.products.columns-4 .woocommerce-loop-product__title {
        padding: 1rem 1.25rem 0.35rem;
        margin: 0;
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        line-height: 1.4;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        overflow-wrap: break-word;
        display: -webkit-box;
        -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
        -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
        overflow: hidden;
      }

      ul.products.columns-4 .codex-catalog-summary {
        padding: 0 1.25rem;
        margin: 0 0 0.65rem;
        font-size: 0.88rem;
        color: var(--codex-text-muted);
        line-height: 1.55;
        display: -webkit-box;
        -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
        -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
        overflow: hidden;
        flex: 1;
      }

      ul.products.columns-4 .button.product_type_simple {
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        margin: auto 1.25rem 1.25rem;
        padding: 0.55rem 1.25rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--codex-border);
        border-radius: var(--codex-radius-pill);
        background: transparent;
        color: var(--codex-text);
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        text-decoration: none;
        transition: var(--codex-transition), background-color 160ms ease;
        cursor: pointer;
        align-self: flex-start;
      }

      ul.products.columns-4 .button.product_type_simple:hover {
        background: var(--codex-bg-warm);
        transform: translateY(-1px);
      }

      /* Double breadcrumb on hero pages — hide the second one */
      .woocommerce-products-header .kadence-breadcrumbs + .kadence-breadcrumbs {
        display: none;
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Contact Page Polish
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      /* Collapse oversized hero on contact page */
      .entry-hero-container-inner .hero-section-overlay {
        min-height: auto;
        padding-top: 1.5rem;
        padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
      }

      .entry-hero-container-inner .hero-section-overlay .entry-hero-container-inner {
        padding-top: 0;
        padding-bottom: 0;
      }

      /* (Interactive link styles consolidated above) */

      /* Jump-nav active state via scroll observer */
      .codex-editorial-jump-link[aria-current="true"],
      .codex-editorial-jump-link.is-active {
        background: var(--codex-gradient-dark);
        color: #fff;
        border-color: transparent;
      }

      /* ═══════════════════════════════════════════
         Responsive
         ═══════════════════════════════════════════ */

      @media (max-width: 767px) {
        .codex-product-support,
        .codex-article-support,
        .codex-collection-support {
          padding: 1.15rem;
        }

        .codex-product-support__grid,
        .codex-article-support__grid {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        }

        .codex-collection-cta {
          grid-template-columns: 1fr;
          padding: 1.25rem;
        }

        .codex-collection-cta__actions {
          grid-row: auto;
        }

        .codex-collection-cta__primary {
          width: 100%;
          justify-content: center;
        }

        .codex-collection-guidance {
          padding: 1.15rem 1.25rem;
        }

        .codex-growth-hub {
          padding: 1rem;
        }

        .codex-growth-hub__hero,
        .codex-growth-hub__group,
        .codex-growth-hub__brief {
          padding: 1rem;
